div.span:
Recharts Multi-Axis Graphs (LiveChart.tsx)
X-axis (Time: 0s -> 1.5s) remains strictly Left-to-Right
Force (Left Y-axis) & Gyro/Accel (Right Y-axis) remain fixed

Western Digits (0, 1, 2... 9)
Preserves standard sensor units (N, deg/s, m/s^2, dBm)

Stipple Orb Canvas (StippleOrb.tsx)
Physics-based 3D particle lighting & drag coordinates are invariant

Flexbox & Grid Automatic Reversal
• Brand Emblem moves to Right
• Status Pills move to Left
• Sidebar / Tabs mirror alignment

Typography System
• Arabic font fallback (Cairo / IBM Plex Sans Arabic)
• Balanced line heights for Arabic descenders

Directional Icons
• Chevron & Arrow icons flip direction where appropriate

getTranslation(lang, key)
Traverses nested dictionary keys ('dashboard.hero_title')
